field_evidence.dataset_title: Fires in London - cause of ignition is white goods
field_evidence.description_scope: Fires where the ignition source is recorded as white goods, with borough and ward location, white-goods type, property type, and where known brand/model.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade dataset 'Fires in London - cause of ignition is white goods'. The dataset provides fire records by London borough and ward location and white-goods type, is updated annually, has Ward as its smallest geography, and its current resource 'Fires in white goods from 2009' covers January 2009 through July 2025. This batch binds the verified Campden ward identity to that unused ward-level source window; Campden-row extraction, geometry and parcel spatial join remain deferred to local OpenCode.
